name: Deep Cold
description: Something under the city has been listening since before the outbreak. Sarge says leave it. Sarge is saying it to you, so.

stages.text: Down. Past the deepslate. Where the lanterns are blue.
Do not make a sound. Then make one, on purpose.

on_complete.text: &7It is very quiet down here now. You made it that way.

rewards.title: &3&lDeep Cold
rewards.subtitle: &7You woke it. You put it back.

locked: &fSarge: 'Leave it. I mean that. When I stop meaning it, ask again.'
